newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Reynolds IPO to do well -issue manager.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Reynolds IPO to do well -issue manager.

text.p: Aluminium producer Reynolds Philippine Corp's shares IPO is expected to do well as it had received a good response from foreign investors, issue manager All Asia Capital and Trust Corp said on Monday.

The foreign tranche was three times oversubscribed after underwriters ended a three-day roadshow for international investors last week, All AsiaCapital executive vice president Eleuterio Coronel said.
Reynold's initial public offering of 238 million shares will open on February 5 and end on Feburary 18.
Of the 238 million shares to be offered to the public at 4.55 pesos, 45 percent will be alloted to overseas investors, All Asia Capital said.
The public will own 34 percent of Reynolds' expanded capital after the offering.
